rows.coder_note: Step 2 (uniquely identifying citation, rule F): three adjacent sentences form one description of the PRACTICAL GWAS meta-analysis and close on citation [19], whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-018-0142-8 is the source of exactly one outcome row. The stated 79,148 cases and 61,106 controls differ from the row's 79,194 and 61,112 but identify no other row, so they are not a conflict (rule H).
